findings.description: plans/ralph-pipeline-05-agent-exports.md is the tracked canonical Plan 05 doc referenced from plans/ralph-pipeline-INDEX.md, but its body still reflects the pre-refinement plan and contradicts the shipped diff in several material places. (1) Line 5 says 'Position in DAG: depends on Plan 01. Independent of 02/03/04', but the updated INDEX shows 05 depends on Plan 02 and the worktree code reuses Plan 02's mergeAndWrite/writeSidecar/sync-lock APIs. (2) Line 60 says appendActivity is called BEFORE the sidecar write ('so activity reflects the transition; ordering matters'), but the shipped watcher in scripts/lib/watch-ralph-state.mjs calls appendActivity AFTER mergeAndWrite (which itself writes the sidecar) returns successfully, matching the refined plan.md F-007/F-011 contract that activity is appended only after a successful merge. (3) Line 61 says the watcher must capture prevStage from in-memory state before deriving the new state; the shipped implementation moved that responsibility into sync-core's deriveActivityEvents inside mergeAndWrite. (4) Lines 62 and 140 say to 'migrate OverviewRalphState.runDurations to Snapshot.runDurations and remove from OverviewRalphState' and to verify 'the sidecar .js/.json no longer carries this field', but OverviewRalphState never had runDurations on main — both the shipped types.ts diff and Plan 04's corrected wording confirm runDurations is a brand-new field on Snapshot only. (5) Lines 63-65 and 141 instruct edits to 'D:\harness-efforts\codexu\CLAUDE.md (root)', but the fork uses AGENTS.md at the repo root (CLAUDE.md is gitignored upstream) — the shipped diff correctly edits AGENTS.md. (6) Line 138 keeps 'npx ajv validate -s ... exits 0' as an AC, but the refined plan F-008 dropped the ajv-cli criterion (ajv ships only the ajv library; ajv-cli is a separate package) in favor of a programmatic vitest assertion.
findings.suggestedFix: Bring plans/ralph-pipeline-05-agent-exports.md into agreement with the refined plan at .ralph/jobs/ralph-pipeline-05-agent-exports/plan.md and with the shipped diff: (a) update the DAG header to 'depends on Plan 02' and add a note that the watcher/sync-core API is reused; (b) rewrite the 'BEFORE the sidecar write' bullet to say activity events are derived inside mergeAndWrite and appended by the watcher AFTER mergeAndWrite resolves successfully, still inside the lock window; (c) drop the watcher-side prevStage capture instruction and point to deriveActivityEvents in scripts/lib/sync-core.mjs as the single derivation site; (d) replace the 'migrate OverviewRalphState.runDurations' wording in both the file list (line 62) and ACs (line 140) with 'add new Snapshot.runDurations field; OverviewRalphState is unchanged because runDurations was never added to it'; (e) replace every 'D:\harness-efforts\codexu\CLAUDE.md (root)' reference with 'AGENTS.md (root)' (lines 63-65 and 141); (f) replace the 'npx ajv validate' acceptance criterion (line 138) with a vitest-based ajv check, matching plan.md F-008's resolution and the actual fixture in scripts/lib/emit-snapshot-schema.test.mjs.
findings.resolution: Updated plans/ralph-pipeline-05-agent-exports.md: DAG dependency on Plan 02, activity events derived in mergeAndWrite and appended after successful merge, Snapshot.runDurations as new field, AGENTS.md replacing root CLAUDE.md, and vitest-based ajv check replacing npx ajv CLI criterion.

findings.description: AGENTS.md (root) lines 16-18 and tools/overview-viewer/CLAUDE.md line 59 both describe the Ralph state artifacts as 'generated by scripts/sync-ralph-state.mjs --watch, which is auto-started by pnpm overview'. The behavior is operationally correct (artifacts do regenerate when pnpm overview is running), but the mechanism stated is inaccurate: 'pnpm overview' runs 'pnpm --filter @codexu/overview-viewer dev', which loads vite.config.ts. The Vite plugin ralphStateWatcherPlugin() (vite.config.ts line 143 in the worktree) imports scripts/lib/watch-ralph-state.mjs directly via dynamic import and calls watcher.start(...) — it does not spawn the scripts/sync-ralph-state.mjs CLI with --watch. The CLI entrypoint with --watch exists (pnpm sync-ralph-state:watch in package.json) and is the operator-facing path, but it is not what 'pnpm overview' invokes. This wording will mislead an agent who tries to debug startup by looking for a sync-ralph-state child process spawned by the dev server.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust both pointer paragraphs so they describe the two equivalent entry paths accurately. Suggested wording: 'Artifacts are emitted by the shared watcher in scripts/lib/watch-ralph-state.mjs, which is started inside the Vite dev server by ralphStateWatcherPlugin() in tools/overview-viewer/vite.config.ts during pnpm overview, or as a standalone process via pnpm sync-ralph-state:watch (scripts/sync-ralph-state.mjs --watch). Both paths share the same .ralph/overview-sync.lock and emit the same set of files.' Apply the equivalent edit in tools/overview-viewer/CLAUDE.md's '## Ralph state sidecar' section.
findings.resolution: Rewrote watcher pointer paragraphs in AGENTS.md and tools/overview-viewer/CLAUDE.md to describe both entry paths accurately (in-process Vite plugin via pnpm overview, standalone pnpm sync-ralph-state:watch). Noted shared lock and identical artifact set.
